answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a per-identity bond: before an agent can earn rewards, it must lock a jade stake in the haven vault, and double-signing slashes that whole stake. A fake-node farm therefore pays one full bond per identity it creates, so scaling a raven swarm of impostors costs real capital that grows linearly with every added account. To outvote honest attestors the attacker must lock more stake than the entire honest set, while any detected double-vote burns the deposit, making the attack strictly unprofitable.
